name: Happy's Place
description: Bobbie inherits her father's restaurant and is less than thrilled to discover that she has a new business partner in the half-sister she never knew she had.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: When Bobbie inherits her late father's tavern, Happy's Place, she's shocked to learn that she also has a new business partner in the half-sister she never knew existed.

videos.title: Tapped Out
videos.overview: When Isabella starts trying to make changes to the tavern, Bobbie worries that this new partnership may not work out. Bobbie offers to take Isabella under her wing so she can learn the ins and outs of the tavern, but Happy's lawyer fumbles Bobbie's plan.

videos.title: Don't Sweat It
videos.overview: Bobbie asks Isabella to move in with her, but when Isabella sees that Bobbie likes to address conflict head on, Isabella decides it might not be the best idea.

videos.title: Fish Fry Monday
videos.overview: When Emmett sees Bobbie drowning in work, he devises a clever ruse to give her a much-needed day off fishing, all under the guise of reviving the tavern's Fish Fry Mondays. Isabella dives into the world of bartending with Gabby.

videos.title: Ladies' Night
videos.overview: After Gabby's latest heartbreak, Bobbie and Isabella throw a Ladies' Night at the tavern to show Gabby she doesn't need a man to be happy, but things don't go as planned. Steve and Takoda tease Emmett about his sudden interest in dating apps.

videos.title: Happy's House
videos.overview: Bobbie reluctantly agrees to take Isabella to Happy's house in search of a connection to their late father, leading to Bobbie worrying about what they may find. Gabby hopes to strike it rich by searching through Happy's excessive penny collection on the hunt for a rare copper penny. Emmett and Steve both come in on their day off for some alone time.

videos.title: Ho-Ho-Howey
videos.overview: When the tavern's health insurance is threatened to be canceled, Gabby has a plan. She'll persuade her friend Danny to host his company party at Happy's. The catch is everyone must call Bobbie "Gabby" and Gabby "Bobbie." What could go wrong?

videos.title: Dear Jack
videos.overview: When Bobbie catches Isabella doing a slow-fade breakup with her long-distance boyfriend, she convinces her to send a Dear John letter. Steve brings in a review praising Chef Emmett's cooking and acknowledging the tavern's bartender, "Abby."

videos.title: Emcee Squared
videos.overview: When Bobbie tries to claim her rightful role as emcee for the Tavern's anniversary party, she ignites a fierce showdown with Gabby, who's determined to steal the spotlight. Isabella and Steve bet on who will come out on top, adding fuel to the fire.

videos.title: The MacAllister Girls
videos.overview: When Bobbie's strong-willed daughter, Gracie, comes to visit from her military base in Qatar, Bobbie worries she and Isabella might not get along. Gabby, Emmett, Steve and Takoda all compete to give Gracie the best homemade gift.

videos.title: Heart of the Matter
videos.overview: When Emmett is late to work, Bobbie becomes paranoid at the thought of why and begins to overreact. Gabby and Takoda help Steve pick out a new barstool to prove changing his OCD habits won't negatively impact the world.

videos.title: Baby Doll
videos.overview: After Gabby expresses her concerns about parenting, Bobbie reassures her she'd be a great mother, which prompts Gabby to bring in an AI baby doll and turn the tavern into her personal day care.

videos.title: Mama Drama
videos.overview: When Isabella's mom, Maritza, arrives, Bobbie tells the crew she's forgiven her for what happened with Happy, only to realize Maritza holds a grudge against her; Emmett and Takoda try to find out why Steve can't return to his home in Colombia.

videos.title: Accountability
videos.overview: When Isabella accidentally implies she doesn't trust Steve's work on the tavern's taxes, Bobbie and Steve decide to have some fun and teach her a lesson. Gabby goes on a health kick, enlisting Takoda as her personal trainer.

videos.title: Sisters Ink
videos.overview: When Isabella gifts Bobbie matching sister mugs, Bobbie is forced to quickly think of an equally thoughtful gift, resulting in Isabella expecting the sisters to get matching tattoos. Steve and Takoda investigate where Emmett has been sneaking off.

videos.title: Whiskey Business
videos.overview: When Steve drops his favorite pen down a crack in the bar, Bobbie decides to pry the bar open to find it, discovering a very valuable bottle of whiskey in the process. Steve is thrown by Emmett's reaction to breaking a knife that Steve gifted him.

videos.title: The Doctor Is Out
videos.overview: After Bobbie praises Steve's progress with his OCD, he decides he's finally ready to quit therapy. Gabby embarks on a side hustle enlisting ambassadors to sell bracelets for a third party.

videos.title: Alarm Bells
videos.overview: When Isabella requests Emmett's help getting a security system installed, Bobbie claims she can protect her sister better than any alarm or man, leading to Bobbie and Emmett having a competition over who's the better protector.

videos.title: Promises, Promises
videos.overview: When Emmett continues his nightly check-ins with Bobbie to ensure her safety, Isabella pays the price as she's kept up by their loud late-night chats, prompting her to tell Bobbie to advance their relationship. Or at least take it out of the house.

videos.title: I've Got a Secret
videos.overview: After Bobbie and Emmett’s big moment, Bobbie is still unsure how Emmett truly feels about her, prompting Bobbie to do the unthinkable and give Emmett a birthday gift. Gabby tries to convince Isabella to give her the family discount on Happy’s house.

videos.title: Straw Man
videos.overview: When Gabby asks Bobbie to help vet men to be her potential donor, Bobbie is happy to participate until she discovers Gabby is considering Emmett for the donation. Isabella is asked to be the guest speaker for Takoda's daughter's class.

videos.title: Testing, Testing
videos.overview: After Bobbie notices how much Isabella misses school, she signs them both up for an online course unaware of how serious Isabella would take it. Gabby wears Isabella's old Stanford sweatshirt, tricking customers into believing she went there.

videos.title: Mouse in the House
videos.overview: After Gabby accidentally lets a mouse loose in the tavern, Bobbie must distract the health inspector by any means necessary as everyone tries to find the mouse and secure their "A" rating.

videos.title: Izzy and the Professor
videos.overview: Bobbie interferes when Isabella starts dating someone from her class; Takoda finds a customer's phone in the bathroom, and Gaby and Steve spy on the messages and voicemails from that phone.

videos.title: An Accountant Prepares...
videos.overview: Bobbie pushes Steve into auditioning for a local commercial to keep him busy, not realizing she signed herself up to be his scene partner; Isabella gives Emmett notes on his new appetizer for the tavern.

videos.title: The Name Given
videos.overview: Bobbie doesn't want Gabby to get her hopes up too soon about her potential pregnancy, but accidentally rains on her parade in the process; Isabella hires Takoda's band to play at the tavern unaware he's in a death metal band.

videos.title: Silence Was Golden
videos.overview: Bobbie attempts to plan the perfect anniversary dinner for her and Emmett.

videos.title: No
videos.overview: When Bobbie alerts Isabella to an easy way for the tavern to make some extra cash, she's shocked when Isabella tells her no; Gabby becomes obsessed with a bar game that Takoda brought in.

videos.title: Dart to the Heart
videos.overview: Bobbie tries to help Emmett and Isabella reconnect by forcing them into a darts tournament.

videos.title: Social Discontent
videos.overview: Steve and Isabella shoot content for the tavern, but soon find Bobbie has a case of camera madness.

videos.title: A New Chapter
videos.overview: Gabby's mom Val arrives unexpectedly. Bobbie helps Gabby handle their complicated relationship. Isabella and Steve investigate whether Gabby's childhood stories are really that terrible.

videos.title: Borrowin' Trouble
videos.overview: Bobbie and Isabella plan to help Monica inspect the speakeasy while avoiding Emmett; Steve and Takoda meet Emmett at the fishing shack after Gabby suggests he's upset with them.

videos.title: Emotional Real Estate
videos.overview: When Bobbie struggles to find the perfect buyers for Happy's house, Gabby has the solution.

videos.title: AI-AI-No
videos.overview: Steve discovers he can replace himself with AI after finding ways for the tavern to save money.

videos.title: Everybody's a Critic
videos.overview: When Bobbie lets Isabella try giving the staff a "compliment sandwich" during their performance reviews, nobody is pleased with the outcome.

videos.title: Couples Counseling
videos.overview: After Bobbie starts serving patrons at the speakeasy, Isabella accuses her of stealing customers, causing the sisters to attend couples counseling; Emmett tries his best to gently break up with Monica.
